20.  Section  49  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended by the repeal of the proviso to subsection (3) of
that section and the substitution therefor, of the following :-
“Provided that in every other case some other Judge
of the High Court of the Republic of Sri Lanka, the
High  Court  for  the  Province  established  by  Article
154P  of  the  Constitution,  the  District  Court,  Family
Court,  Small  Claims  Court,  Magistrate  of  the
Magistrate’s Court and Judge of the Primary Court, as
the  case  may  be,  of  any  adjoining  zone,  district  or
division  shall  have  jurisdiction  to  hear,  try  and
determine  such  action,  prosecution,  proceeding  or
matter.”.
